concerns.text: FR-007 introduces a full sensitivity‑analysis sweep (cut‑offs 2, 3, 4) and reports ‘spike_point’ and ‘slope_change’. The original idea never requested a threshold‑sweep or any sensitivity analysis; it only asked to quantify latency scaling and accuracy penalty. This adds work outside the defined research question and constitutes scope over‑reach.

The idea’s research question explicitly includes an *accuracy penalty* (“how does logical complexity interact … to determine the latency and accuracy penalty”). The specification, however, only measures translation‑error rate (FR‑004/FR‑008) and latency; it does not define or collect any retrieval‑accuracy metrics such as precision, recall, or MAP. This omission leaves the ‘accuracy penalty’ component of the original question unaddressed, representing an under‑reach.
